objective: Perform interrupts operation 2 on Intel 8085 processor.
theory: The Intel 8085 is an 8-bit NMOS microprocessor with a 16-bit address bus and 8-bit data bus. This program implements interrupts using accumulator A and register B.
algorithm: 1. Load 1st operand from RAM 2050H into Accumulator A.
5. Store result at RAM 2051H and halt.
flowchart: START -> Execute Interrupts Step 1 -> Process Data -> Verify Flags/Result -> END
assembly_code:
; 8085 Interrupts Exercise 2
LDA 2050H
MOV B, A
MVI A, 02H
ADD B
STA 2051H
HLT
step_by_step_execution: Step 1: Fetch and decode Interrupts instruction for Intel 8085.
Step 2: Read input operands from memory / registers.
Step 3: Execute ALU operation for Interrupts.
Step 4: Update status flags (Z, CY, S, P).
Step 5: Store final result into memory.
explanation: This program demonstrates interrupts on the Intel 8085 architecture.
common_mistakes: Forgetting to clear carry or flags before loop.

viva_questions.q: How many T-states does LDA instruction take in 8085?
viva_questions.a: 13 T-states (4 Machine Cycles: Fetch, Read, Read, Read).

viva_questions.q: Which flag is affected by ADD instruction?
viva_questions.a: All status flags (S, Z, AC, P, CY) are updated based on ALU result.
